annotation.justification: The phrase 'a protocol that supports renegotiation' is insufficiently constrained. It could refer to HTTP/1.1 specifically, or any protocol capable of renegotiation. annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the server is specifically requesting HTTP/1.1, or simply any protocol that supports renegotiation. This affects how a client should respond to the error.
